svg.title: The frequency plan of transmon_surface17
svg.desc: The frequencies of the 17 qudits, one row each, on an axis in GHz: the 0-1 transition, the 1-2 transition below it by the anharmonicity, and the readout resonator. The data qudits have their 0-1 transition at 3.740 to 4.143 GHz and their resonators at 6.769 to 7.180 GHz; the X auxiliaries have their 0-1 transition at 5.885 to 6.097 GHz and their resonators at 7.258 to 7.554 GHz; the Z auxiliaries have their 0-1 transition at 5.956 to 6.328 GHz and their resonators at 7.200 to 7.502 GHz.
